With you behind the wheel, every delivery becomes a party! And you get paid well for it  too. With flexible working hours, almost anything is possible.

Want to know more? Read on to check out the rest of the job opening!

What we offer
- A great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks

- Freedom on the road with a truck full of goodies

Who you are
As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you deliver groceries right to the customer's front door. You are physically fit and have no problem lifting crates. You can also easily step in and out of the delivery van on a regular basis.

In addition, you bring the following to the table:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transportation to get to Heyderweg 2-6 in Leiden.

From well-known cities to tiny villages you didn't even know existed: that is what awaits you as an Albert Heijn delivery driver. Every day is different. Fortunately, you are well-prepared during your onboarding period and you know how to keep a cool head! There are also plenty of opportunities to grow. For instance, you can quickly start working as a buddy, guiding and training new employees. Or you can become a plusser, making sure every driver hits the road fully equipped with all the essentials.

To keep the warehouse process running smoothly, it's important that you'll meet the following requirements:

- You can speak and understand the English language well.
- You are available 5 days a week from Monday to Friday.
- You are available for work between 08:00 and 20:00.
- You have your own transportation to reach the location in Roermond.
- You are physically able to perform work in a cold working environment.

What will you do
As a logistics assistant, you ensure that vital medical products are processed safely and delivered on time. Your working time will be between 08:00 - 20:00. When you start your workday, you’ll be checking, sorting, and preparing packages for shipment. A crucial role in the healthcare chain! You will work in a clean, climate-controlled environment where quality is the top priority. To top it off, you’ll receive an extra €80 per month cold-environment allowance! In short, your responsibilities include:

- Checking incoming packages
- Sorting on the conveyor belt
- Loading and unloading
- Labeling and shipping
